title: Grateful Dead Live at Labor Temple on 1969-04-27

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of a ferocious 4/27/69 Labor Temple show – Dark Star, twin Lovelights and a smoking St. Stephen sequence dominate an unforgettable night.
ai_review.review: The tape captures one of the most intense spring‑'69 performances, highlighted by an expansive Dark Star, two powerful Lovelight sandwiches, a tight St. Stephen > Eleven medley and soaring moments on Sitting On Top of the World. The soundboard source is remarkably clear – even Mickey’s occasional “bird‑chirp” percussion cuts through, and the mix stays balanced throughout the marathon set.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently five‑star praise for both musical performance and audio clarity; only minor cataloging complaints, no serious recording flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, well‑balanced mix with audible drums throughout; occasional anecdotal bird chirping noted but adds character. No major dropouts or muffling reported.

standout_songs: Sitting On Top of the World
poor_songs: Sitting On Top of the World (indifferent version per one reviewer)
show_quality.setlist_flow: A single, marathon set with a Lovelight sandwich and seamless segues into Me & My Uncle and Morning Dew; the show flows like a continuous improvisational journey.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar work shines – a jam out of Dark Star into Me & My Uncle, plus the trademark “bird‑chirp” percussion moment that adds a mystical vibe.
band_member_comments.Phil: Strong interaction with Jerry throughout Dark Star; occasional tenuous moments in Me & My Uncle but overall powerful bass presence.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey’s drumming is clearly audible and even produces the quirky bird‑chirp sounds that some listeners noticed.
